title: Receipt
description: A durable record of an action's effect (spec section 7; decision 0020, D-P0-10). Every action ends with exactly one final receipt, phase committed (it took effect) or aborted (it didn't). Economic actions (offer, give, write_book, read_book) first write a prepared receipt (intent to consume), then the final one. The Mind credits only on a committed receipt. Each receipt is its own row with its own receipt_id; (action_id, phase) is unique, so a repeated action writes no second receipt for the same phase.

kind.description: The action's `do` verb, the same value as ActionRecord.kind.

phase.description: prepared is the intent to consume; committed and aborted are the final phases.

item.description: The item consumed or moved, when the action has one.

credits.description: Credits granted. The Mind credits only on a committed receipt.

detail.description: What happened, for example why an action aborted.
